messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Lately, {01 00 00 05 00}I've been curious
about other people's
rooms, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.
{07 14 00}And I really want to see
YOUR room, too{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.

{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}So could I come by and
check out your house,
{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Viimasel ajal {01 00 00 05 00}olen ma olnud
uudishimulik teiste
tubade suhtes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.
{07 14 00}Ja ma tahan väga näha ka
SINU tuba{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.

{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Kas ma võiksin läbi astuda
ja su maja vaadata,
{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, this is probably going
to sound nosy and weird,
{04 1f 00}, but...
{07 0d 00}I want to see the inside of
your house!{01 00 00 05 00} So can I come
over sometime?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, see kõlab ilmselt
uudishimulikult ja veidralt,
{04 1f 00}, aga...
{07 0d 00}Ma tahan näha su maja
seestpoolt!{01 00 00 05 00} Kas ma võin
kunagi külla tulla?
